title: The Garden Row with Two Names
youtube_title: The Garden Row with Two Names | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Friendship makes room before it keeps score.
summary: At a schoolyard with a low swing and a circle of stones, Kira is just outside the fun, close to a plant label that could carry two names. Milo changes the seating, the rules, or the pace so Kira has a real place, not a prize announced out loud. Cousin Pio lets the children solve it.
